newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real slightly down on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real slightly down on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real fell a slight 0.01 percent to close at 1.0765 per dollar on Thursday in the commercial foreign exchange market following a 0.09 percent decline in the real-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The new mini-band was set between 1.0755 and 1.0805, against the previous mini-band between 1.0745 and 1.0795, they added.
So far this month, the mini-band has fallen 0.51 percent against the dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0809 per dollar, down 0.07 percent.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.70 percent to close at 1.130 against the greenback.
